work.name: Lilith Games - AFK Journey
work.summary: Built C++, C#, Lua, and Python runtime, performance, and developer tools for an award-winning open-world mobile game used by millions of players.
highlights: Cut runtime memory 60% (2.5 GB to 1.0 GB) by profiling allocations, replacing high-overhead containers, adopting memory-mapped loading, and redesigning data pipelines.
Extended stable sessions on memory-constrained 3 GB devices beyond one hour by identifying retained objects and memory leaks, reducing allocation churn, and mitigating fragmentation.
Cut startup latency 75% (40 seconds to 10 seconds) by redesigning data parsing, asynchronous I/O, and resource-loading workflows across startup-critical pipelines.
Cut animation runtime memory 85% and per-asset size 90% through demand loading, lifecycle management, and compression.
Optimized a multithreaded small-map renderer for 500+ dynamic objects using LOD, vertex reduction, camera smoothing, and draw-call reduction.
Built automated asset-processing, FlatBuffers export, resource-management, and visual-effect performance-grading tools supporting production content workflows.

work.name: Lilith Games - AFK Journey
work.summary: Built Unity game-engine features and content tools using C++, C#, Lua, and Python.
highlights: Built Infinite Map Zoom with responsive boundary drag and pinch, seamless 3D-to-2D transitions, and camera, map, and icon gesture logic without noticeable loading.
Implemented rule-based 2D mini-map icon rendering and built map-copy, FlatBuffers export, and resource-management tools supporting designer and artist workflows.

projects.name: ECG Modeling Research
projects.summary: Modeled noisy single-lead ECG from hospital polysomnography studies to estimate AHI, an indicator of sleep apnea severity.
highlights: Built a reproducible preprocessing and model-comparison pipeline evaluating ResNet-18, MultiRocket, TabPFN, XGBoost, and foundation models.

projects.name: UI Fault Detection Capstone
projects.summary: Generated synthetic rendering faults from real mobile application screenshots.
highlights: Trained a 2D CNN classifier to detect UI rendering defects, achieving 0.87 test accuracy.

projects.name: Huawei CodeCraft Algorithm Competition
highlights: Improved the time complexity of C++ directed-graph cycle detection and centrality-ranking algorithms.
